params.prompt: Five-second cinematic environmental-laboratory technology film, 16:9, silent. Use the reference image for the clean modern laboratory, microscope, sample bottles, glassware, petri dishes, cool daylight, and realistic material detail, without preserving the exact static framing. Begin with a smooth low camera move along the laboratory bench past clear water samples and glassware, showing subtle liquid refraction, reflections, and changing highlights. Continue toward the microscope with a controlled push-in and natural rack focus from foreground samples to the microscope stage and optics. Near the end, transition optically into a brief plausible microscopic view of suspended particles or simple aquatic micro-organisms, as though seen through the instrument, while keeping the transition physically believable rather than holographic. Laboratory equipment remains stationary and correctly shaped. No people, floating tools, animated instruments, readable results, fabricated labels, impossible liquid motion, sudden cuts, or flashy interface graphics.
